entity: canonical Microsoft building or complete OSM subdivision child with Microsoft provenance
candidate_denominator: in-service matched geometry-clear residential and unknown buildings; exclude explicit nonresidential/mixed and clear zero-only unknown

neighbor.reference: original clear single-source residential observations passing the independent building-scale screen
neighbor.scale: RMS differences of independent same-type geographic reference-neighbor pairs
neighbor.target: equal mean squared group contribution on scale-fitting pairs
neighbor.estimator: weighted median log units with weights (1+distance)^-2
neighbor.support: held-out calibrated mean neighbor distance and weighted log-unit P90-P10

scale_screen.missing_height: similarity-supported P90 of original independent training heights; explicitly marked
scale_screen.interpretation: loose consistency screen, not a measured capacity or legal occupancy limit
